fields.value: Tampere University Rotated Circular Array Impulse Response Dataset(TUNI-RCAIR)

dsDescriptionValue.value: The TUNI-RCAIR dataset consists of impulse responses collected from different spaces in the Tampere university campus, Finland. Each folder represents a data collection environment, and it consists of impulse responses and recorded data in the form of wav files. Each space has its own three alphabet identifier, for example- Anechoic chamber is represented as AEC. The folder names indicate the space and corresponding identifier There are seven different data collection environments, and the distance between the source and receiver is varied thrice (0.7m, 1.4m, and 2.1m), which can be found in the names of the sub folders. Further details about the dataset, the characteristis of the space used for data collection, can be found in the page - https://tuni-rcair.github.io/ This dataset is accepted as a part of EUSIPCO 2021, the name of the corresponding paper is, "Tampere University Rotated Circular Array Dataset". The link to the paper will be updated. EUSIPCO paper DOI - https://doi.org/10.23919/EUSIPCO54536.2021.9616072 For citation please use - A. V. Venkatakrishnan, P. Pertilä and M. Parviainen, "Tampere University Rotated Circular Array Dataset," 2021 29th European Signal Processing Conference (EUSIPCO), 2021, pp. 201-205, doi: 10.23919/EUSIPCO54536.2021.9616072.
